subject: german

rounds.lie: “Ich wohne seit fünf Jahren hier” means “I will live here in five years”.
rounds.why: Wrong: “seit … hier” with the present tense means “I have lived here FOR five years” (an action continuing from the past).
rounds.truth: “Ich wohne seit fünf Jahren hier” means “I have lived here for five years”.

rounds.lie: “Ich fahre lieber in die Berge” means “I never go to the mountains”.
rounds.why: Wrong: “lieber” means “rather/preferably”, so it expresses a preference, not “never” (= “nie”).
rounds.truth: “Ich fahre lieber in die Berge” means “I'd rather go to the mountains”.

rounds.lie: “Wir haben die Ferien am Meer verbracht” means “We needed the holidays by the sea”.
rounds.truth: “Wir haben die Ferien am Meer verbracht” means “We spent the holidays by the sea”.

rounds.lie: “Meine Stadt ist sehr lebhaft” means “My town is very lifeless”.
rounds.why: Wrong: “lebhaft” means “lively/bustling”, the opposite of lifeless. “Lifeless” would be “leblos”.
rounds.truth: “Meine Stadt ist sehr lebhaft” means “My town is very lively”.

rounds.lie: “Der Flug hatte Verspätung” means “The river was delayed”.
rounds.why: Wrong: “der Flug” means “the flight”, not the river. “The river” is “der Fluss”.
rounds.truth: “Der Flug hatte Verspätung” means “The flight was delayed”.

rounds.lie: “Ich wohne in einem Reihenhaus” means “I live in a detached house”.
rounds.why: Wrong: “das Reihenhaus” is a “terraced house”. A detached house is “das Einfamilienhaus” (freistehend).
rounds.truth: “Ich wohne in einem Reihenhaus” means “I live in a terraced house”.
